reviews.text: They are a very professional and dedicated team. Great!

I only have words of gratitude. With them, I always felt safe, calm, and cared for, and my dog ​​was always looked after. Right up until the very end, they treated us with great respect and affection.
They truly convey what they feel: love for animals and respect for their companions. Thank you so much for everything.

Very nice doctor and friendly staff. Despite the language barrier, our Labrador received quick help. Thank you so much!

When I adopted my first cat over a year ago, I chose this vet because I read excellent reviews, and it was definitely the right choice. They treat my girls, Lia and Chloe, very well and have always been successful with their treatments. I hope it always stays that way. All the professionals who work there are amazing, with so much empathy and compassion.

Four months ago, I took my sick kitten Luca to the vet for a checkup. A woman named Daniela committed an unforgivable act of negligence. She gave me a wrong diagnosis, saying my kitten was fine, just a behavioral problem. Honestly, that seemed very strange to me. Anyway, she's the one who understands things, so she put me in touch with an ethologist. Four months later, the kitten was still sick, and the ethologist wasn't convinced and sent him back to Daniela for more tests. Imagine my surprise when this woman calmly told me my cat needed emergency surgery because he had a urethral plug in his penis—basically, it was blocked, which is why he couldn't urinate. I had to figure things out on my own and find a hospital to get Luca admitted as soon as possible. He had the surgery, and thankfully, everything went well. Little Luca is recovering. All of this happened this past weekend. You can't imagine the shock and stress I've been under because of how awful it's been for me and my kitten. Don't trust Daniela. That's what I want to tell you most. What shocked me was that she didn't even apologize for the huge mistake she made. My God, what a lack of empathy, understanding, and sensitivity! I almost lost Luca, and she was so calm, knowing perfectly well that the mistake was solely hers. She was only interested in charging me for the tests and nothing more, without any remorse. Please, let no one else have to go through what I went through. What a waste of time and money! Four months of suffering for my kitten and me. I spent a total of 3,000 euros in four months. The operation cost me 2,000 euros, the rest was for tests, medication, the ethologist, blah blah blah. Luca's penis was blocked; he had many stones. It's no wonder, after four months like that, they almost amputated his penis. If he had died, I would have sued her. The funniest thing is that she thinks I'm going to take my cats back to her clinic. My God, does she really think I'm that stupid?

I take my two cats to this clinic and I couldn't be more grateful.

I especially want to thank Daniela and Stefano for their dedication, professionalism, and the care they show the animals, explaining everything so well. They always keep the cost as affordable as possible.
Every time I go, I have complete peace of mind knowing my cats are in the best hands.

They have a special way of connecting with them, conveying calm, security, and lots of love. Thanks to this, they've been able to perform tests that would have required sedation elsewhere. That level of trust and empathy is hard to find.

Thank you for taking such good care of Mizar and Parche and for making every visit a positive experience. You can tell they love what they do!

A year ago, we brought our Lunita, a 17-year-old mixed-breed senior dog, to the vet. We knew she needed help to spend her remaining time without pain or suffering, and that's exactly what they did. We couldn't be more grateful for the wonderful care they provided, from the veterinarians to the receptionist. They were professional and loving until the very end. Fifteen days ago, we had to say goodbye after a long and happy life. They were with us and her until the very last moment, and today, we have her ashes with us. Thank you; they were truly a great team of professionals.
Professional and friendly. They advise you every step of the way... They treat your pet like it's their own. Highly recommended.
Good professionals

As for the veterinarians, I must say they are true professionals. However, the receptionist leaves much to be desired, as she lacks manners. For example, yesterday, while waiting to go in with my dog, a man came in asking if they had left some keys, which he had lost. Her response: "Only dogs are allowed in here." It would have been so easy to reply, "No, sir, not here."

Dr Stefano and Laura were very kind and accomodating even with last minute emergency. Diagnosis and treatment were 100 percent correct for my daisy. even with my lack of spanish skills they could have said no easily to help my dog, and also VERY FAIR with pricing unlike others I called. HIGHLY RECOMMEND
